title: Automatic Renewal, Opt-Out and Rollover: Small Business Electricity Supply Terms and Conditions
content:
## Clauses

**A.** On a Small Business Electricity Supply plan whose automatic renewal is enabled, an expiring term renews automatically into the plan and rate offered in the governing final options notice, starting the day after the contract end date, unless the business declined.

**B.** A decline is accepted only when the business declines no later than the plan's opt-out window days (15 calendar days on every plan) after the final options notice was issued. Day one is the calendar day after the final options notice's notice date, and the opt-out window closes at the end of the calendar day equal to that notice date plus 15 days. The notice date is read from the final options notice on record for the agreement.

**C.** A business may decline automatic renewal only on an active agreement.

**D.** Automatic renewal also does not occur when either expiration notice was missing or not compliant, when the agreement is drop pending at expiry, or when the plan's automatic renewal is not enabled.

**E.** When the term neither renews nor auto-renews, the agreement converts on the day after the contract end date to the plan named as the rollover plan, at the month-to-month rate stated in the final options notice; when either notice was missing or not compliant, the expiring rate is held for the plan's rate-hold cycles (2 billing cycles on every plan) first.

**F.** An automatically renewed term earns no renewal loyalty credit, and during its first automatic-renewal free days (60 calendar days on every plan that renews automatically) the business may cancel without an early termination fee.

**G.** A decline can be reversed only by an explicit renewal acceptance.

## Whether an expiring term renews automatically

| Plan renews automatically | Business declined in time | Both notices present and compliant | Drop pending at expiry | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| yes | no | yes | no | automatic renewal into the offered plan and rate, from the day after contract end |
| yes | yes | any | any | no automatic renewal |
| yes | no | no | any | no automatic renewal |
| yes | no | yes | yes | no automatic renewal |
| no | any | any | any | no automatic renewal |

Where there is no automatic renewal and no explicit renewal, Clause E applies.

## Opt-out window, hypothetical dates

| Final options notice date | Decline made on | Accepted |
|---|---|---|
| 1 December | 2 December (day one) | yes |
| 1 December | 16 December (last day) | yes |
| 1 December | 17 December | no |

## Rollover rate, hypothetical cases

- Both notices compliant, no renewal: from the day after contract end the agreement is on Beacon Ridge Business Monthly Variable at the final options notice's month-to-month rate.
- The initial renewal notice was issued late, no renewal: the agreement converts to Beacon Ridge Business Monthly Variable, and its expiring rate is billed for the first 2 billing cycles before the final options notice's month-to-month rate applies.
